description: Measure per-pattern compact ratios (bytes before and after encoding) on a sample pulled from the customer's SIEM and run through a local engine; a ratio on that sample, not a SIEM meter reading. Pulls `sample_size` events for a service over `timeRange`, runs them through the local tenx engine, and returns per-pattern `compaction_ratio_x` (original bytes / encoded bytes) derived from that sample. Use this to replace the destination's default compact ratio in `log10x_estimate_savings` (one measured capture per destination, named in `compact_ratio_basis`) with ratios measured on this customer's sample. Requires: tenx CLI installed locally (LOG10X_TENX_PATH or `tenx` on PATH) AND SIEM credentials (same as `log10x_poc_from_siem_submit`). Confidence tiers: high (>=50 events), medium (10-49), low (<10). Results flow into `log10x_estimate_savings` to improve savings projections. REQUIRES a local engine: the tenx binary on PATH, or Docker with LOG10X_TENX_MODE=docker.

environment.description: Log10x environment id. Omit to use the default environment.

sample_size.description: Number of events to pull from the stack for measurement. Default 500. Larger samples improve confidence (high confidence requires >=50 events per pattern) but take longer to pull and process.

service.description: Service name to scope the stack sample to. Used as the query filter (e.g., Datadog `service:<name>`, Splunk `sourcetype=<name>`, CloudWatch stream prefix).

timeRange.description: Lookback window for the stack pull. Format: <N><unit> where unit is m (minutes), h (hours), or d (days). Default "24h".

name: log10x_measure_compaction
title: Measure compaction
